The Prime Minister Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP) is the most suitable option for your dairy venture. It covers the allied‑sector dairy activity and provides a substantial capital subsidy, which helps lower the amount you need to raise.  

Other schemes such as MUDRA are also applicable, but PMEGP offers the best overall support for this type of project. You can review the details through the official PMEGP portal linked in the report.
